content.text:
I can't compute either percentage because the orders data isn't in my working directory.

I listed `/tmp/r2run-0iokyq2z`. It contains only dotfiles and a `.claude` configuration folder. None of the 58 IURC orders for 2021–2025, and no extracted case table, are present. The only files of any kind are environment configuration, and I did not open them because they don't hold case data.

To get the two numbers, I need the order PDFs or text for the 2023 and 2024 orders, or a CSV/JSON extract with one row per case that includes the order year, respondent name, and the committee's recommendation text. With that, I can apply the definitions you gave:

- **(a)** Among non-utility respondent cases in each year, the share whose headline penalty is at least $5,000. The denominator is all non-utility cases in that year, including $0 cases.
- **(b)** The share of all cases in each year whose respondent starts with one of the listed utility prefixes, rounded to one decimal.

I did not substitute an estimate, since neither figure can be reasonably approximated without the case data.
